title: "The Chessboard of Destiny Trembles"
next_chapter_hook: "At the very instant when information surpassing language pierced his consciousness like an ice pick, Chen Ji perceived that the entire heavens and earth seemed to freeze in that moment—and on his chessboard of destiny, the 49th chess piece, which should have always obeyed, was trembling at a诡异的 frequency, as if responding to some older, vaster will."

text.content: "The token glowed faintly in Chen Nian's palm, as if calling out to something. Chen Ji knew the next truth was about to be unveiled—and the price might be heavier than three years of feigning death. Yet the instant he lifted his foot to move, a dull rumble echoed from the depths of his Mental Sea—the wail of the chessboard of destiny."

"Chen Ji froze mid-step, his expression shifting drastically. Three years of planning, refining the Tianji Record Fragment into a chessboard of destiny, placing all heroes under heaven into his game—every chess piece under his control, including the 49th, the most hidden and crucial one. But at this moment, a诡异的 tremor rose from the depths of the chessboard, as if something was awakening, breaking free from his control."

dialogue.content: "Impossible... A chess piece I crafted myself, how could it..."

text.content: "Chen Ji immediately sat cross-legged, his spiritual sense rushing like lightning into his Mental Sea. The chessboard of destiny floated in the void, three hundred and sixty-five chess pieces each in their positions, emitting faint fluorescent light—only the 49th, the last piece he placed, the most insignificant and dull chess piece, was trembling at a诡异的 frequency, as if responding to some older, vaster will."

"Just as Chen Ji tried to suppress the anomaly with his spiritual sense, the void tore apart. A gaze transcending language and sensation burst forth from the depths of the chessboard—not a gaze, yet more suffocating than any gaze—as if the entire heavens and earth had become a pair of eyes, examining him from beyond infinite dimensions."

"Three words, not sound, yet directly branded into Chen Ji's spiritual consciousness. Immediately after, countless images flooded in like a deluge—the ancient era, the first prophet kneeling with the Tianji Record Fragment in hand; generation after generation of inheritors manipulated by fate, ultimately reduced to chess pieces; and he, Chen Ji, three years ago when he accidentally activated the fragment, those eyes that had watched him from the void—now, those eyes were fully open."

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Eye of Heavenly Mandate—the existence that existed only in legends, about which even Mo Xiansheng refused to speak, was gazing at him, this 'self-proclaimed game master,' this ant. There was no hostility in that gaze, nor goodwill either—only a lofty, indifferent detachment as one examines chess pieces."

dialogue.content: "...So that's how it is. The awakening of the 49th chess piece was no coincidence—it was a hidden piece you placed."

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly rose, a self-mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips. He had always believed he walked the world with a废物 persona, secretly plotting against all under heaven, the one manipulating this game. But in truth, he was merely a self-righteous chess piece in a grander game—and now, the one controlling the game had personally entered the field."

"That information transcending language flooded into his spiritual sense once more, this time carrying a near-playful scrutiny: 'You are a more interesting chess piece than the previous generations. Knowing you are a piece, yet not going mad; discovering the chessboard has changed hands, yet not despairing. Do you want to reclaim control, or...go with the flow?'"

choice.prompt: "Faced with the scrutiny of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, Chen Ji needed to respond—his choice would determine the next direction."

choices.description: "Chen Ji冷笑，既然您老人家愿意看戏，那我就把这出戏唱完。第49号棋子既然敢叛逃，那就让它知道谁才是真正的执棋人。代价是大天命值消耗，但能向天道之眼展示自己的价值。"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, his spiritual sense becoming countless threads, forcibly wrapping around the trembling 49th chess piece. Heavenly Fate points flowed away like water, a sense of emptiness instantly spreading through his body—but he gritted his teeth and forcibly suppressed that anomaly."

"The chessboard returned to superficial tranquility, the 49th chess piece sinking back into silence. But Chen Ji knew this was merely appearance—the gaze from the Eye of Heavenly Mandate still existed, even...with a hint of amusement. As if saying: somewhat interesting, but that's all."

choices.description: "既然您老人家想看戏，那我就演给您看。陈机决定不强行压制，而是顺着那股异动，将第49号棋子引导向一个更有利于自己的方向。展现他作为“棋子”的利用价值。"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not forcibly suppress; instead, he released his hold on the 49th chess piece, allowing that anomaly to spread—but at the same time, his spiritual sense wrapped around it like silk threads, not to suppress, but to guide."

"A hint of approval came from that gaze? Or perhaps just Chen Ji's错觉. But immediately after, more information flooded in—about the true origins of the Tianji Pavilion emissary, about the truth behind the 'accident' three years ago, and a fact that made his spine chill: he thought he was plotting against all under heaven, but in truth, every move he made was under the watchful gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate."

choices.description: "既然这枚棋子已被更高存在染指，那留着就是隐患。陈机决定壮士断腕，以牺牲这枚关键棋子为代价，向天道之眼展示自己的决断力——这枚棋子，连同它背后的一切，他都不要了。"

text.content: "A fierce glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. His spiritual sense became a blade, slashing toward the 49th chess piece without hesitation—if this piece was no longer pure, keeping it would be a disaster. Chen Ji had always relied on his resolve to cut losses at any moment, never on any single chess piece."

"The piece shattered with a soundless wail, dissolving into scattered starlight. At the same moment, the chessboard of destiny shook violently, a backlash force rippling back along the invisible threads of causality—Chen Ji grunted, a trickle of blood appearing at the corner of his lips. But his eyes remained clear, even carrying a hint of satisfaction: pieces can be rearranged, but once control of the chessboard is lost, everything is lost."

"Chen Ji steadied his mind, lifting his head to face that omnipresent gaze. He knew the three choices just presented were merely a test—what the Eye of Heavenly Mandate truly wanted to see was his response to absolute power. And now, the final piece of information arrived from that gaze, carrying the authority of judgment:"

dialogue.content: "'Interesting. Since you possess such clarity, I shall give you another chance—submit, or be destroyed?'"

text.content: "The words fell, the void trembled. Chen Ji sensed a world-ending force gathering, as if the slightest misstep would reduce the entire Tianqing Sect, and everything he had plotted, to dust in an instant. Such was the power of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate—transcending all rules, towering above all beings. And he, Chen Ji, before such an existence, was merely an ant among ants."

"Yet the corner of Chen Ji's lips slowly curved upward. It was the smile of one who, knowing death is certain, still dares to pull a tooth from a tiger's mouth. He recalled himself three years ago, when he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment—that废物 disciple eking out a humble existence among sect servants. Now he was still a '废物,' but this废物 had acquired the ambition and筹码 to撬动天下."

dialogue.content: "'Submit or be destroyed...Heh, you've given quite the choice. Unfortunately, I, Chen Ji, never choose the options others give me.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, the chessboard of destiny manifesting behind him. All three hundred and sixty-four chess pieces hummed in unison, responding to their master's call. He knew that with his current strength, resisting the Eye of Heavenly Mandate was impossible. But he still had one card to play—the chess piece hidden deep within the Tianji Record, not even discovered by the Eye of Heavenly Mandate."

"At that moment, Mo Xiansheng's weak yet urgent voice echoed from the depths of his Mental Sea: 'Chen Ji! Don't act rashly! The Eye of Heavenly Mandate is not invincible, but definitely not now—you need the complete form of the Tianji Record, and right now, you haven't even awakened one-tenth of it!'"

"Chen Ji did not answer. He stared at that gaze transcending time and space, at those eyes examining the chessboard, and suddenly a疯狂的 idea surged in his heart: since the Eye of Heavenly Mandate treated every generation of prophets as chess pieces, then he would be the piece that refuses to be manipulated—and moreover, he would be the one manipulating the game."

"'Mo Xiansheng,' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm, 'You said nine-tenths of the Tianji Record remains unawakened. So, what if I burn all three hundred and sixty-four chess pieces to exchange for a brief complete awakening—would that be enough to have a go at this 'Eye of Heavenly Mandate'?'"

"Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then let out an ancient sigh: 'You madman... very well, since your mind is set, I shall tell you a truth. The complete form of the Tianji Record is called the 'Counter-Destiny Chapter'—it can briefly rewrite causality, creating cracks in既定命运. But the price is, the practitioner will forever lose the qualification to inherit the Tianji Record, becoming a complete 'outsider.'"

"Outsider—losing the ability to foresee the future, losing the support of the chessboard of destiny, losing all筹码 gained through the Tianji Record. From then on, he, Chen Ji, would be utterly reduced to a mortal, never again able to glimpse heavenly secrets or plot against all under heaven. This price was more terrifying than death."

"Yet Chen Ji laughed, the smile carrying a near-mad洒脱. He thought of those he had plotted against, of those chess pieces manipulated on his board, of Su Qingyao worrying for him deep within the Tianqing Sect's Inner Sect, of his sister Chen Nian who had been taken by the Holy Sect to become the Heavenly Fate Lock—"

dialogue.content: "If I must hesitate at this moment of choice, then what was the point of obtaining the Tianji Record in the first place? To be a piece that can foresee the future yet is forever manipulated by others?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He did not choose to submit, nor to be destroyed—he chose to burn everything,换取 an 'equal dialogue' opportunity with the Eye of Heavenly Mandate. Even if it was merely a moment, even if the price was losing everything, he would make those lofty eyes understand: he, Chen Ji, was never anyone's chess piece."

"The instant before Chen Ji was about to ignite the chessboard of destiny, that information from the Eye of Heavenly Mandate suddenly changed—no longer scrutiny, no longer pressure, but a near-surprised emotional fluctuation: 'Oh? You dare... Interesting. Very well, this round, I'll call it courage.'"

"That gaze slowly retreated, the void returning to tranquility once more. The anomaly of the 49th chess piece also ceased—or rather, was forcibly suppressed by some higher will. Chen Ji gasped, collapsing to the ground, his entire body soaked in cold sweat. Just now, he had truly tasted the flavor of death—not from an enemy, but from that transcending everything heavenly mandate."

"Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of fatigue and relief: 'Boy, you've got luck. The Eye of Heavenly Mandate seems to have developed an interest in you—not a good thing, but not entirely bad either. At least you have time before it gazes upon you again.'"

dialogue.content: "Time... Heh, I've never lacked time. What I lack is the moment when my opponents realize that I, Chen Ji, am not a chess piece.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji struggled to stand, his gaze falling on the token in Chen Nian's hand in the distance. The token still glowed faintly, as if calling out to something. He knew the next truth was about to be unveiled—and this clash with the Eye of Heavenly Mandate was merely the beginning of a grander game. Now, he had something he should have done long ago—to find that Tianji Pavilion emissary and clarify the true reason for the 49th chess piece's awakening, and the tangled因果 it shared with the Eye of Heavenly Mandate."
